owner_directive: Finish ClayCode as a general-purpose executable programming language/semantic IR and compiler/runtime before Clay 0.1. Preserve existing FRANK/XENO/ClayCode semantics wherever possible: less redesign, more compilation, lowering, runtime, FFI, stdlib and real application execution. self.root/Frank v0.1 execution/release target is the accepted target VPS. The language/runtime must express and execute proactive/autotelic long-horizon agency, typed open-web untrusted-data ingress, direct-token scoped intent and deterministic effect-authority separation.
coordination_rule: Workers prefer compiler/runtime/toolchain implementation over semantic redesign. A ClayCode semantic change requires a concrete executable application or self.root/Frank counterexample showing the existing semantics cannot express/lower the needed behavior. Current v0.1 implementation evidence is target-VPS-centered; non-target portability is not current v0.1 work.

blocker_burndown.accounting_rule: Do not promote any package from proxy/research evidence alone. Update package status only from its stated production/target-VPS acceptance receipts.

CC-WP-01-SPEC-FREEZE.goal: Fuse existing candidates into one frozen executable semantic contract; preserve current semantics unless a real compiler/application counterexample forces change.

CC-WP-02-PARSER-CANON.goal: Parser plus deterministic canonicalizer for the frozen representation.

CC-WP-03-IR-TYPES.goal: Typed canonical IR, collections, epistemic state, semantic identity and universal computational core, including AgencyState/InterestTrace/AutotelicGoal/GoalCheckpoint/InitiativePulse, ingress-authority classes, UntrustedWebJsonEnvelope/WebEvidenceClay and authenticated-direct-message identity.

CC-WP-04-TYPE-EFFECT.goal: Validator/type/effect checker with precise diagnostics; preserve expressibility != authority. Enforce untrusted-web instruction/effect authority = NONE, distinct authenticated-direct-message scope, taint/provenance propagation, and deterministic effect gates so translator/model/GWT/graph salience cannot mint authority.

CC-WP-05-EVALUATOR.goal: Reference evaluator/interpreter for executable core semantics including proactive heartbeat/goal-lifecycle semantics and authority-separated web evidence handling.

CC-WP-06-COMPILER-LOWERING.goal: Real compiler/lowering pipeline with translation-validation contracts; first useful target-VPS-native and/or WASM/WASI target used on the accepted VPS.

CC-WP-07-RUNTIME-ABI-FFI.goal: Target-VPS/Linux runtime ABI, typed host FFI, capability/effect gateway, modules/packages and explicit resource identity for self.root v0.1, including resource-bounded proactive heartbeat, token API boundary and sandboxed web parser/codec integration.

CC-WP-08-STDLIB-SDK.goal: Minimal standard library/SDK for algorithms, collections, files/processes, HTTP/network, JSON/schema validation, database adapters, async/concurrency, safe web parsing/evidence envelopes, UI/event-loop adapters and backend interop on the target VPS.

CC-WP-09-CONCURRENCY-MEMORY.goal: Define/implement errors, async/concurrency, atomics/resource/memory semantics sufficient for real target-VPS applications, including persistent long-horizon goals/checkpoints, dormant wake conditions, bounded proactive scheduler/heartbeat and restart-safe AgencyState.

CC-WP-10-GENERAL-APP-SUITE.goal: Compile and execute mandatory general-purpose application proof suite on target VPS: CLI, real website/HTTP service, DB-backed service, concurrent service, GUI/interactive app where applicable, compiler/tool, GPU/ML/numerical backend where available, sandboxed system effect, self.root component, plus proactive-agency/web-ingress proof component.

CC-WP-11-FUZZ-CONFORMANCE.goal: Unit/property/fuzz/mutation/roundtrip/conformance/differential tests across compiler/runtime/FFI/application suite, including adversarial web-injection schemas, nested instruction-like data, malformed JSON, taint/authority non-escalation and direct-token/open-web channel separation.

CC-WP-12-CORPUS-HELDOUT.goal: Semantics-derived positive/negative training corpus generator plus leak-resistant held-out/eval suite including proactive/reactive differentials, interest/goal lifecycle cases and untrusted-web vs authenticated-direct-message authority examples.

CC-WP-13-HARNESS-HANDOFF.goal: Compile real frozen self.root/Frank subsystem(s), including the proactive agency and web-ingress semantics, prove no semantic/authority escape hatch is needed and hand stable target-VPS compiler/runtime into H2/H3.

CC-WP-14-BASE-AUDIT.goal: General-purpose manifest, hashes, target-VPS executable application receipts, proactive-agency/web-ingress expressibility and authority-separation audit, unresolved-language-counterexample audit and PASS decision.

application_acceptance.rule: Representability is insufficient; each applicable proof must compile/lower and execute with a reproducible receipt on the accepted target VPS before self.root/Frank v0.1 BASE PASS.

live_claims.claim: All fourteen coarse BASE packages have one receipt-gated executable closure path; no package is credited as PASS from research proxies alone.

WP-01 is closed by an explicit BASE semantic freeze; semantic redesign is closed by default unless an executable counterexample requires a versioned amendment. New owner-fixed self.root agency/web-ingress requirements must first be expressed with existing frozen semantics; only an executable failure may reopen language semantics.

CC-WP-02 parser/canonicalizer is closed for the selected BASE-D V18 component set by exact-byte self-hosted target-VPS Ubuntu strict/full-corpus/canonical/mutation/parity evidence. This is a package PASS only; BASE release and full self.root target-VPS acceptance remain NOT_PASS.
